title: Prime Minister's Office (Public Service Division, Science and Technology Policy and Plans Office)
what_it_is: Prime Minister's Office (Public Service Division, Science and Technology Policy and Plans Office)

sections.label: Whole-of-Government services and capabilities
sections.summary: The passage states plans to enhance citizen and business services, scale digital platforms, pool science and technology capabilities, and develop public officers.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: For citizens, we will enhance integrated and seamless services through whole-of-Government (WOG) efforts like ComLink+, Municipal Services Office and ServiceSG.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: For businesses, we will streamline processes, simplify regulations and strengthen support through efforts like the Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises Pro-Enterprise Office.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will also scale up WOG digital platforms such as GovWallet and YourBenefits to strengthen service delivery, while maintaining a human touch.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will expand and pool science, technology and engineering capabilities and resources across Government agencies, in areas ranging from urban planning and design to tunnelling.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: The Public Sector Science and Technology Policy and Plans Office will coordinate cross-agency efforts to assess interdependencies in areas like power and transport, and to manage greenhouse gas emissions.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: The Public Service Division will continue to refresh its employee value proposition to attract diverse talent and support career longevity.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Our training and development efforts will provide more opportunities for attachments and secondments to the private and people sectors and international organisations, to broaden officers’ skills and experiences.

sentences.speaker: The Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Leadership development will be enhanced to build the capabilities of both individual leaders and leadership teams.
